automated_tests.sources: Simulated Notion workspaces and plugin relays; real MCP HTTP and stdio clients

headless_checks: Root returns machine-readable JSON even when HTML is requested
Former UI and setup routes return 404
Console cookies cannot authenticate management requests
OAuth callback returns JSON without UI redirect
No UI assets or launchers in source archive

live_notion.session_requirement: An active agent host with the connected Notion plugin must relay live reads, source verification, and refreshes. The local index persists between sessions.
not_verified: Two separately authorized live customer workspaces

limitations: Lexical retrieval; no embedding-based semantic search
Initial plugin index is bounded and partial, not an entire-workspace completeness claim
Attached binary contents and comments are not extracted
One service process with persistent SQLite storage
Some hosted MCP clients need additional client-facing OAuth support
archive: Source only; excludes credentials, private connection state, indexed Notion content, logs, and dependencies
